Class LogProperty.PropertyKeyBuilder<T>

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.AbstractKeysBuilder<LogProperty.PropertyKeyBuilder<T>>
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.PropertyKeyBuilder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - value type.
Enclosing interface:
LogProperty
public static final class LogProperty.PropertyKeyBuilder<T> extends LogProperty.AbstractKeysBuilder<LogProperty.PropertyKeyBuilder<T>>
Builds a LogProperty.Property (or a LogProvider via provider(LogProperty.PropertyFunction)) that is looked up under one or more keys tried in order: if the value is not found under the first key added, the next key added is tried, and so on. Created via LogProperty.PropertyGetter.withKey(String).
